story.title: Bumble kills the swipe and bets on AI matchmaking assistant 'Bee' to reinvent online dating
story.summary: Bumble CEO Whitney Wolfe Herd announced the dating app is eliminating its signature swipe mechanic and pivoting toward AI-driven matchmaking, including a new AI dating assistant called Bee. The company is positioning AI as a 'supercharger to love and relationships', signalling a fundamental redesign of how hundreds of millions of users interact with the platform. The move marks one of the most high-profile consumer AI pivots in the social app space, with implications for how AI agents may mediate personal relationships at scale.
